digest.component_or_area: contribution guidelines and code review documentation
propositions: Gerrit changes with known unresolved issues must be marked as Work In Progress to enforce holds that are otherwise invisible in ticket comments and session logs.
Authors and agents must use either the push-time syntax `%wip` or the REST endpoint `/wip` to mark a change WIP, and `%ready` / `/ready` to unmark it once issues are resolved.
The WIP hold requirement must be documented in CONTRIBUTING.md §2d, mirrored in the packaged code-review guide accessible via `rebar explain review`, and referenced in AGENTS.md.
Documentation and packaged guides must be synchronized through the generated criterion-pins manifest, verified by tests that load guides through the packaged registry rather than file paths alone.
